title: I made a bunch of tiny 3D html games under 200kb with Claude
author: PhotographNo7254
selftext:
Check them out - [gamestovibe.com](http://gamestovibe.com)

So I love the concept of vibe coding. I think it has bought a lot of freedom to creative non coders like me to at least get a decent looking gameplay MVP to market without spending an actual bomb! 

Would love for you to take my tiny games for a spin and let me know which one's your favourite. And oh - the leaderboards are yours to conquer!

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Thanks! Can I crowdsource bugs if you encountered any?

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Nice start, a few bugs to work now. Now how do you plan to distribute?

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: I'm all ears on the bugs! I dont have a plan as yet to distrubute though. Just experimenting for now.

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: should have tried to make one game that works instead.

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Ouch! That hurt man! Did they not work for you? I'm loading the libraries externally at runtime maybe that's the issue. Care to help me out?

replies.author: mallcopsarebastards
replies.body:
yeesh, I'm way too snarky on the internet.   
the ones that I played all work as in they all run, but seem a bit buggy. I'll give these a closer look today and see if I can give you some more actionable advice. Sorry!

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Hey no worries! :-) I truly appreciate your time and look forward to any feedback

comments.author: Lirezh
comments.body:
That reminds me strongly on those early 2000 games for PC. "Olympic Wintergames".  
Basically a set of minigames.  
It looks like one-shot AI game development is about at that stage.

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Thanks for checking it out! I do plan to release games on a weekly basis here. Would love your feedback and get better.

comments.author: okdata41171
comments.body: Starting small is the way to go.

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Yeah I look at a lot of amazing Indie developers and that's a north star some day 😁

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
Hey my friend I am building a game portal for browser based games! Would love to have them included on our site SLAGDOCK, 

  
A link can work long as it can be embedded or you can upload the html or files

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Sure thing. I think you can easily do up an iframe if you want...some of them are connected to a back end for leaderboards so just html files probably wouldn't work.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
Sounds good! Looks like there are only a few so I can surely add them all if iframe link works on the embed. What shall we put down as the release dates for these titles?   
also GamesToVibe as the developer name? 

I will let you know once I had added them all and tag you in the formal posting once the site is officially live

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: I think all the non leader board games should work fine with an iframe. CORS might be an issue with leader boards - basically ski, 2105 and rugby. We can test it though. I think 1st of June is perfect for the release date and its a go on the developer name! All the best with your platform. Look forward to check it out!

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/ce6bo3lahyah1.png?width=1036&format=png&auto=webp&s=73df22c62c2e92714d0cf581f813eccfe4e13883

All GamesToVibe games are are up on SLAGDOCK 😄 

ill tag you in the official post when we publish the site

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Super excited to check it out - and definitely opens my eyes on the need to improve the game cover images. What do you think - should I stick with actual gameplay screenshots as the cover or should I create fresh illustrations for a better first impression?

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Hey I updated my cover images. Do you think you could update them in your app as well. Thank you so much for the screenshot. It really showed me how sloppy my cover images were! :-)

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: I will update the cover images and let you know! ty my friend and I actually really enjoy the rugby game haha I was playing it till 2AM last night admitedly lmfao

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: :-P I'm dropping a new game tomorrow. That should be super fun.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: hey there man these new covers look super awesome! Adding them all now

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: really makes the site look better haha ty

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Thanks a ton! Appreciate the kind words :-)

comments.author: Outside_Specific_820
comments.body: great job. Amazing. Tried a few and got hooked, excellent

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Super happy to hear that! Keep us bookmarked for new games every week! :-)

comments.author: SLAGDOCK
comments.body: We can't wait to share these once SLAGDOCK is live!

comments.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
comments.body: The covers are awesome - how did you make them? I couldn't bring myself to click “Pay” in the game “I'm Not A Robot” -\_- . I tried playing all the others, and to be honest, I didn't find any that appealed to me. It's cool that technology lets you do what you love.

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Ahaa... you sure you're not a robot? 😁 Well give it another shot. There are 50 captcha's that are rotated constantly so you have another chance to be human! Made the covers with chatgpt. Took multiple prompts and explaining the gameplay...so not one shot I'm afraid. Glad you liked them. Totally understand you not finding the others as interesting. If you have any ideas, I would love to work on them!
